nodes.name: Append Timesheet Row
nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Add Microsoft 365 OAuth2 credentials in n8n
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_WORKBOOK_ID with your OneDrive file ID
   (Open the file in OneDrive → Details pane → copy the ID, or use the file browser in this node)
   OneDrive link: https://1drv.ms/x/c/77ddc9c9e315f12a/IQDST4yOPnkbTIHCx01vRhdFATmq0qk0BaJBcv9C3q_gQHY
3. Ensure your Excel sheet has columns: Date, Employee, Email, Project, Hours, Description
